_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for EDGE-HIGH-VALUE. Two assertions in schemaFixtureFactory.test.ts: (1) live hand-written EDGE_HIGH_VALUE.payload in formPathScenarios.ts deep-equals this snapshot; (2) toScenario(EDGE_HIGH_VALUE_JOURNEY).payload deep-equals this snapshot.
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written scenario held old-schema values that current V2 builder cannot produce. Corrections: (1) propertyType 'Independent House' REMOVED (no V2 schema question binds propertyType); (2) purchaseType 'Direct Sale' → 'resale_normal' (raw V2 option value); (3) constructionStatus 'Ready to Move' → 'Flat' (builder maps constructionType Flat/House/Floor → constructionStatus; 'Ready to Move' was a PropertyStage value); (4) propertyStage 'Ready To Move' added (flagKey side-effect of purchaseType='resale_normal'); (5) carpetArea/carpetAreaUnit/carpetAreaRaw added from propertyCharacter page; (6) ocCcAvailable 'BOTH' added (surfaced for Flat+RTM on merged complianceLegal page); (7) titleChainStatus/encumbranceCertStatus REMOVED (both hidden for PLANNED_AUTHORITY — their showWhen requires CONVERTED_RESIDENTIAL/OLD_MUNICIPAL/LOCAL_COLONY/UNKNOWN); (8) sellerOwnershipType/propertyAcquisitionMethod/sellerOnLoan/lastRegistryDuration/isAnyBuilderDemand added from sellerTransaction page; (9) assessmentStatus/auctionPropertyStatus/registryTimeline added; (10) documentationReadiness added with valid PLANNED_AUTHORITY values (SALE_DEED/OC/CC/EC); (11) grossIncome/netIncome REMOVED from applicant — Self-employed(Other) path in applicantPayload.ts does NOT set those (only Salaried/Pensioner paths do); (12) Obligation defaults (totalLimit/remainingLimit/utilizedAmount '0' strings, obligationType 'term_loan') added via cleanObligationEntries(); obligation id 'obl-high-value-1' pinned deterministically; (13) constructionType Flat used (not Independent House) — if House were set, ocCcAvailable would be hidden and municipalApproval would surface, adding unrelated complexity to this high-value edge.
